text: This report is filed regarding Arslan Ghani (CNIC 413131-5552416-7), a student with a declared monthly income of PKR 20,000, whose account PK**HABB****1319 exhibits classic money mule characteristics. Between May 2 and May 10, 2026, the account received 16 distinct inbound IBFT transfers totaling approximately PKR 923,000 from numerous unrelated individuals, including Mehwish Imtiaz, Usman Javed, and Hamid Nawaz. This volume is grossly inconsistent with the subject's student status and low income. The funds were rapidly swept out of the account via two large wallet transfers to QuickPay wallet ***0932 (PKR 285,000 on May 5 and PKR 287,000 on May 10) and two ATM withdrawals at Blue Area, Islamabad (PKR 201,000 on May 9 and PKR 74,000 on May 11). Notably, two sender banks have issued fraud recall requests citing scam complaints, indicating the inbound funds are likely proceeds of fraud. The rapid movement of funds, high number of counterparties, and mismatch with the customer's profile strongly suggest the account is being used to layer illicit funds.
